{{Quote|Well, that droid wasn't kidding. Tell the base that we'll be able to make it back when the coast is clear. Thanks again, friend... you just saved a lot of lives!|Captain Montrasword|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Montrasword''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelFirstLieutenantTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Captain Montrasword]]
Montrasword appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-Player Character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the appearance of Montrasword changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the canonical [[Species/Legends|species]] of Montrasword. Although Montrasword was identified as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Montrasword in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], examining Montrasword revealed him to also be a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]].
